app.name: Care Me
app.tagline: Free, confidential counselling from the Ministry
app.prototype: Prototype with fabricated demo data only
app.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development, Social Security and Community Empowerment

common.name: Name
common.resetDemoConfirm: Reset all demo data? Every change you made in this browser will be lost.
common.pageNotFoundBody: The page you were looking for does not exist.
common.forbidden: You do not have access to this page
common.forbiddenBody: Your role does not include permission to open this page. If you think this is wrong, contact the Ministry administrator.
common.emergencyAlwaysAvailable: In an emergency call 119 at any time.
common.footerPrivacy: You do not need to give your name to use this service.

home.title: Someone to talk to, in your language
home.lead: Talk to a trained Ministry counsellor in Sinhala, Tamil, English or sign language. It is free and confidential.
home.anonTitle: You do not need to register
home.anonBody: You can take a self-assessment and read resources without giving your name. We only ask for your details if you book a session.
home.how1Body: A short questionnaire helps you understand how you are feeling. Results stay on your screen.
home.how2Body: Search by district and language and pick a time that suits you.
home.how3Title: Meet by video, audio or chat
home.how3Body: Sessions last up to 60 minutes. Sessions are never recorded.
home.privacyBody: Messages and reminders we send never mention counselling. Only your counsellor sees your case notes.
home.quickCheckLead: A few short questions, just for you. Nothing is saved.
home.resourcesLead: Short, practical guides in your language.
home.findLead: Choose your district and the language you would like to talk in.

breathe.title: Let's take one slow breath together.
breathe.lead: Sometimes, giving yourself a moment to pause can make a difference. Follow the circle and breathe at a comfortable pace. Stop whenever you need to.
breathe.disclaimer: A gentle breathing exercise. Stop at any time if it feels uncomfortable.

auth.loginLead: Log in to manage your appointments, or as Ministry staff.
auth.attemptsRemaining: {{count}} attempt(s) left before the account is locked.
auth.mfaLead: We sent a 6-digit code to your registered phone.
auth.registerLead: An account lets you keep your appointments and self-assessment history in one place. You can also use Care Me without one.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a number and a letter.
auth.agreeTerms: I agree to my information being used to provide counselling services, as described in the privacy notice (draft).
auth.verifyPhoneLead: Enter the code we sent to {{phone}}.
auth.recoverLead: Enter your email or mobile number. If an account exists we will send a code.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been reset. You can now log in.
auth.demoAccountsLead: Pick an account to fill in the form. All passwords are {{password}}.
auth.endedTimeout: You were logged out after a period of inactivity.
auth.endedRevoked: This session was ended from another device.
auth.endedExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
auth.idleBody: For your privacy you will be logged out in {{seconds}} seconds.
auth.devicesLead: End any session you do not recognise.
auth.mfaSettingBody: Ask for a code sent to your phone each time you log in.
auth.mfaRequiredByRole: Required for your role by the Ministry.
auth.guestNotice: You booked without an account. To come back later, create an account with the same mobile number.

assess.title: Self-assessment
assess.lead: These short questionnaires help you reflect on how you have been feeling. They are not a diagnosis.
assess.stressDesc: How much pressure you have felt in the last month.
assess.anxietyDesc: Worry and nervousness over the last two weeks.
assess.depressionDesc: Low mood and loss of interest over the last two weeks.
assess.wellbeingDesc: How positive you have felt over the last two weeks.
assess.anonNotice: Your answers and result are not saved. Closing or leaving this page clears them.
assess.savedNotice: Because you are logged in, your result will be saved to your history. Only you and your counsellor can see it.
assess.itemsEnglishOnly: Questions are shown in English until a validated translation is approved.
assess.resultSaved: This result was saved to your history.
assess.riskTitle: You said you have had thoughts of being better off dead or of hurting yourself.
assess.riskBody: You do not have to cope with this alone. Please talk to someone now.

prompts.lastTwoWeeks: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following?

options.moreThanHalfTime: More than half of the time
options.lessThanHalfTime: Less than half of the time

bandAdvice.good: Keep doing what helps you. The resources may still be useful.
bandAdvice.mild: Some things are affecting you. Self-help resources may help, and you can talk to a counsellor at any time.
bandAdvice.moderate: This is affecting your daily life. Talking to a counsellor is a good next step.
bandAdvice.severe: This is having a big effect on you. Please consider booking a counsellor soon.

assess.skipped: Please answer this question to continue.

resources.title: Resource centre
resources.lead: Free articles, videos, audio and worksheets to support your wellbeing.
resources.notInLanguage: Not yet available in your language — showing English.
resources.mediaPlaceholder: Media player placeholder. In production this plays from the Ministry's own servers.

search.title: Find a counsellor
search.lead: Choose your district and the language you want to talk in. You will see counsellors' available times.
search.noAvailability: No open times in the next 3 weeks
search.fallbackTitle: No counsellor is available in {{district}} for {{language}}
search.remoteOfferBody: {{name}} ({{district}}) can meet you by video, audio or chat.
search.otherLanguageTitle: Could you talk in another language?
search.otherLanguageBody: We will only show counsellors in another language if you confirm you are comfortable using it.
search.callbackTitle: Ask us to call you back
search.callbackBody: Leave a phone number and a Ministry officer will arrange a counsellor and contact you. A callback is not an emergency service.
search.waitlist: Add me to the waiting list
search.callbackSent: Your request was sent. A Ministry officer will contact you.

booking.title: Book a session
booking.chooseTimeLead: Times are shown in Sri Lanka time. Sessions last up to {{minutes}} minutes.
booking.noSlots: This counsellor has no open times in the next 3 weeks.
booking.mode: How would you like to meet?
booking.detailsLead: We only ask for these now because you are booking. They create your confidential record.
booking.consentCounselling: I agree to receive counselling and for my counsellor to keep confidential notes (draft wording).
booking.minorLead: You are under {{age}}. Before your first session a parent or caregiver needs to give consent (procedure pending Ministry confirmation).

authorityOptions.selfDeclared: Declared by the parent or caregiver

booking.guardianConsent: The parent or caregiver gives consent for counselling.
booking.noSafeCaregiver: I do not have a parent or caregiver who can safely help with this
booking.safeguardingBody: A Ministry safeguarding officer will contact you to arrange support safely. If you are in danger now, call 119.
booking.safeguardingPhone: A safe phone number to reach you (optional)
booking.safeguardingSend: Ask a safeguarding officer to contact me
booking.safeguardingSent: Thank you. A safeguarding officer will contact you.
booking.sessionNumber: This will be session {{n}} of up to {{max}}.
booking.requestedBody: Your counsellor will confirm the request. You can see its status under My appointments.
booking.previewTitle: What the reminder will look like
booking.previewSms: Reminder: you have an appointment on {{date}} at {{time}}. Sign in for details.
booking.capReached: You have reached the maximum of {{max}} sessions. Please talk to your counsellor or the Ministry about further support.

appointments.title: My appointments
appointments.joinOpens: You can join from 10 minutes before the start.
appointments.cancelBody: The time will be released for someone else.
appointments.lateTitle: This is less than {{hours}} hours' notice
appointments.lateBody: You can still cancel, but it will be recorded as a late cancellation and count as one of your {{max}} sessions.
appointments.rescheduleBlocked: Times can only be changed at least {{hours}} hours before the appointment.
appointments.rescheduled: Your new time has been requested.

profile.title: My account
profile.minimalContentBody: Messages outside the app never say you use counselling and never include clinical information.
profile.withdrawConfirm: Withdrawing consent may stop us providing some services. Continue?
profile.erasureTitle: Ask us to delete your information
profile.erasureBody: The Ministry will review your request and contact you. Some records may need to be kept by law.
profile.guardianOnFile: Parent or caregiver consent on file ({{name}}).

emergency.title: Get help now
emergency.lead: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 119 now.
emergency.confirmNumbers: Numbers to be confirmed by the Ministry.
emergency.alertTitle: Ask our emergency officer to contact you
emergency.alertBody: This sends an alert to the Ministry's emergency officer on duty right now.
emergency.phoneOptional: A phone number we can call you on (optional)
emergency.phoneHint: You do not have to give a number to send an alert.
emergency.statusOpen: Waiting for the emergency officer to respond.
emergency.statusAcknowledged: An emergency officer has seen your alert and will contact you.
emergency.statusEscalated: Your alert has been passed to a senior officer. If you are in danger, call 119 now.
emergency.step1: If you can, go somewhere safe and stay with someone you trust.
emergency.step2: Keep your phone close and switched on.
emergency.step3: Breathe slowly: in for four, out for six.
emergency.notEmergency: Not an emergency? You can book a counsellor or ask for a callback.
emergency.callNow: This is the fastest way to get help right now.

session.title: Session room
session.waiting: Waiting for the other person to join…
session.ended: The session has reached its time limit.
session.chatNote: Chat messages in this prototype are not stored.
session.placeholder: Audio and video placeholder — no media is captured in this prototype.
session.notJoinable: This session is not open to join.

portal.onDuty: You are the Emergency Officer this week.
portal.rejectReason: Reason (shared with the client in neutral wording)
portal.reassignLead: Only counsellors who offer {{language}} are listed. The client will be notified.
portal.availabilityLead: Your weekly times appear in beneficiary search. Block a single time if you are away.
portal.newClientLead: For clients seen in person who have not booked online. Only enter what you need.
portal.searchClients: Search by name or client code

case.title: Case record
case.guardianMissing: Minor — parent or caregiver consent required before any session
case.riskLead: This goes straight to the Emergency Officer on duty, who must acknowledge it.
case.riskSent: Risk alert sent to the Emergency Officer.
case.progressLead: Problem rating totals at intake and each follow-up (higher means more difficulty).
case.selfAssessments: Self-assessment results shared by the client
case.formSaved: Form saved to the case record.
case.notesPrivate: Notes are visible only to roles allowed by the permission matrix.
case.noAccess: Your role cannot view this part of the record.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.lead: Record referrals from hospitals, prisons, Grama Niladhari and Divisional Secretariat field officers. External referrers have no access to case records.
referrals.matchLead: Avoid duplicate profiles: link to an existing beneficiary if one matches.
referrals.createPending: No match — create a record pending registration

alerts.title: Emergency alerts
alerts.lead: Alerts routed to you as this week's Emergency Officer. Acknowledge each one as soon as you see it.
alerts.notOnDuty: You are not the Emergency Officer this week. You can still see alerts you raised.
alerts.handoverTitle: Handover: {{count}} open alert(s) from the previous officer
alerts.handoverBody: You are now on duty. Review each open alert below.

admin.usersLead: Create, change, deactivate and reactivate accounts. Roles control what each person can see.
admin.counsellorsLead: {{count}} counsellors. District, language and active status are used by beneficiary search.
admin.rolesLead: Draft least-privilege matrix standing in for Annex 4. Anything not granted is denied.
admin.permissionsSaved: Permissions saved. They apply from the next request.
admin.contentLead: Upload and publish resources in Sinhala, Tamil and English. Users only see published items.
admin.rosterLead: One counsellor is designated each week. Alerts route to whoever is on duty when they are raised.
admin.groupsLead: Schedule group sessions with a participant capacity, manage enrolment and record attendance.
admin.enrolSearch: Search by name or client code
admin.settingsLead: Placeholder values pending Ministry confirmation. Every change is written to the audit log.

fields.mfaRequiredRoles: Roles that must use two-step verification
fields.otpRequiredForRegistration: Require a code to verify mobile at registration
fields.escalationPath: Escalation path (one per line, in order)
fields.maintenanceNotice: Maintenance notice shown to all users

admin.auditLead: Append-only record of sign-ins, changes, configuration and alerts. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
admin.waitlistLead: People who could not find a suitable counsellor. Arrange a counsellor and contact them.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.lead: Counselling activity across the platform. Kalutara January–June 2026 figures come from the district progress deck; monthly split, age groups and other districts are fabricated for the demo.
dashboard.byDivision: Individual sessions by division and concern
dashboard.byDistrict: Individual sessions by district and concern

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Generated directly from platform data. Export to CSV, Excel or PDF.
reports.stubbed: {{format}} export is available in the production build. CSV works in this prototype.
reports.identityHidden: Client identity is hidden for your role.
reports.deckNote: The printed deck total row (Male 135 / Female 243) does not match its own rows (147 / 254, total 401); row values are used.
